title: Voice of Customer
description: Verbatim customer language bank, written by /audience-research to ./brand/voc.md (this schema validates the optional structured mirror). Quoted (never paraphrased) by /direct-response-copy, /positioning-angles, /lead-magnet, and /email-sequences. Every entry carries the verbatim quote, a source URL, and a date. No invented quotes: an empty array beats a fabricated entry.

brand_name.description: The brand this VoC bank belongs to.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last research pass.

pains.description: What customers complain about, in their own words.

desires.description: Outcomes customers say they want, in their own words.

objections.description: Why customers say they don't buy / don't trust the category, in their own words.

switching_triggers.description: What finally made customers switch (or leave a competitor), in their own words, mostly mined from competitor 1-star reviews. IDs use the VOC-S prefix.

vocabulary.description: Community shorthand, jargon, and phrasing to reuse as-is in copy.

id.description: Optional stable citation ID, e.g. 'VOC-P01' (P=pain, D=desire, O=objection, S=switching trigger, V=vocabulary). Downstream files cite these IDs. Never renumber existing ones.

intensity.description: Optional emotional intensity of the quote, 1 (mild) to 5 (raw), as rated at mining time.

quote.description: The verbatim customer language. Exact words, original spelling and punctuation.

source_url.description: URL where the quote was found (review, Reddit thread, G2 page, community post).

date.description: ISO 8601 date the quote was posted (or, if unknown, when it was collected).

source_type.description: Optional: where it came from, e.g. 'reddit', 'g2', 'app-store-review', 'community', 'support-ticket'.

theme.description: Optional: short tag grouping related entries, e.g. 'pricing', 'time-cost', 'trust'.
